lines.text: The apostles performed many signs and wonders, and the believers gathered together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
After someone reported the apostles teaching in the temple courts, the captain brought them gently because an angel warned him.

wrong_details.true: for fear the people would stone them

lines.text: A Sadducee named Gamaliel reminded the Council of Theudas and Judas the Galilean, and urged leaving the apostles alone.
